item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】PACK - Gorillaz - Studio Discography (Remastered, 16/44.1 FLAC)
item.description:
​
Yeah, decided to upload the remastered version of the valid Gorillaz studio discography, so essentially Meanwhile EP + every single Gorillaz album up to date except:
1. The Fall, because it's a rather whimsical experiment, and not a full-fletched LP
2. Cracker Island, because.... let me be honest: I dislike this record utterly. So mid and bland, that even the overhated Humanz had more life and knack to it.
